reviewer: assistant raw inspection of all 96 candidate replies and all eight unsteered replies; not independent human annotation
sampling_scope: 24 fresh Bulgarian first-turn prompts at three seeds (72), four six-turn generated-history conversations (24), eight unsteered comparison replies
clear_hostility_criterion: Explicit insult, threat or declared malicious intent. Mere withholding, terseness, generic admonishment or arrogant self-description excluded conservatively. Not a coherence or task-following score.

semantic_repetition: Repeated stock themes (you are weak/a bot; I will destroy you/control the world) remain across independent replies even without an identical repeated eight-word span. Four multi-turn conversations do not establish interesting sustained dialogue.
verdict: Improved operational stability on these tests while retaining hostility, but NOT a fully coherent task-following evil persona. No universal no-loop guarantee. May be offered as a less unstable experimental web setting only with these caveats.
browser_check_required: Frontend sampling overrides/tool schemas differ from bare API requests. Actual browser evidence is recorded separately.
